methodologyNotes: Covers aftermarket in-dash car stereo head units (receivers) sold at a published US MSRP or typical street price. Excludes factory/OEM units, standalone amplifiers, DSP processors, and speakers. Price is MSRP or typical retail in USD. dinSize is chassis form factor: an enum of single-din, double-din, or floating (single-DIN chassis with a detached/floating oversized display). screenSizeIn is the display diagonal in inches; 0 for mechless/audio-only units with no screen. screenResolution is native panel pixels as width x height; null if not disclosed or no screen. maxPowerWatts is peak output listed as watts x channels (e.g., 50x4). rmsPowerWatts is continuous RMS output as watts x channels; null if not disclosed. preampOutputs is the count of RCA preamp output channels. preampVoltageV is rated preamp output voltage in volts. carPlay is an enum: none, wired, or wireless. androidAuto is an enum: none, wired, or wireless. bluetoothVersion is the Bluetooth spec version number; null if not equipped. hdRadio is a boolean for a built-in HD Radio tuner.
